The Actor 'Maria Chen' must have the email m.chen@greenplastics.example.com. The Source 'HDPE Recycling Energy Study 2023' must be dated 2023. While the task description provides specific names, note that 'Robert Taylor' and the specific study title are synthetic/modified for this task and may not match real-world NREL authorship exactly; the agent must follow the task's provided metadata.
